pattern.description: The camera pushes into the network-flow map, then cuts to the Security Signals UI entering in a strong 3D perspective tilt that rotates and scales down to sit flat, full frame. The caption pill stays fixed in screen space and only swaps its text and gradient colour.
pattern.why_premium: A fixed caption anchors the eye while the product UI swings in under it, so the scene change feels continuous. The decelerating 3D tilt gives a flat screenshot depth and momentum without a hard cut.

build_hint.gsap: Outgoing scene: gsap.to(map, {scale: 1.12, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.in'}). Incoming UI: gsap.fromTo(ui, {rotationX: 35, rotationY: -25, rotationZ: -8, scale: 1.4, transformPerspective: 1200}, {rotationX: 0, rotationY: 0, rotationZ: 0, scale: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: 'expo.out'}). Caption: swap the textContent and the background gradient at the cut (set, no tween).
build_hint.remotion: Interpolate rotateX/rotateY/rotateZ and scale with spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}) (no overshoot) inside a perspective(1200px) container. Pick the caption text with a frame threshold at the cut.

notes: The outgoing network map is not on the end frame, so it has no box; its push-in is described under b01/pattern. Code reports camera push_in for the burst; the main visible motion is the UI 3D untilt. Inner boxes b03-b20 move only with the whole UI, so they are not listed separately.
